svg.title: RapidTinyRec measured floating-point precision frontier
svg.desc: Historical Office A6000 full500 results: FP32 default 114.8 milliseconds median, TF32 research 82.3, BF16 experimental opt-in 56.5. Separate paired experiments, setup excluded. INT8 and INT4 have not been benchmarked.

g.text: Office · A6000 · 500 users · beam 50 · median request latency ↓
Rankings change; equivalent quality is not established. Separate paired controls; setup excluded.
TF32 / BF16 are floating-point modes. INT8 / INT4 quantization: not implemented or measured.
